vibe_rationale: Genuine tattoo scene at the core, but a large, sponsor-branded convention-centre expo that leans commercial rather than curated.
fit_notes: Large adult tattoo audience with skin, aftercare and recovery adjacency, which gives High Ground a real health link. Many partners, including non-tattoo brands, and a sponsorship enquiry page make the route open, but a paid stall or presenting role across three cities is costly and commercial in setting.
